name: aether-edge
description: High-performance typed VLESS & Trojan edge proxy and subscription server on Cloudflare Workers
author: minicx

scripts.build: bun run build:css && bun run build:styles && bun build src/index.tsx --outfile dist/worker.js --target browser --external cloudflare:sockets
scripts.format: biome format --write package.json tsconfig.json biome.json src/index.tsx src/mux.ts src/session.ts src/sub.ts src/trojan.ts src/ui.tsx src/vless.ts scripts/embed-styles.mjs
scripts.lint: biome lint src/index.tsx src/mux.ts src/session.ts src/sub.ts src/trojan.ts src/ui.tsx src/vless.ts scripts/embed-styles.mjs
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck
